## COMPLETE ErrorCode ENUM (apps/core/enums.py:277–336)

# Auth
INVALID_CREDENTIALS         → HTTP 422  (raised in LoginView when authenticate() returns None)
ACCOUNT_NOT_VERIFIED        → HTTP 422  (raised in LoginView when user.is_verified is False)
TOKEN_EXPIRED               → HTTP 422  (raised by token validation services; no direct view reference found in read files)
TOKEN_INVALID               → HTTP 422  (raised by token validation services; no direct view reference found in read files)
LOGIN_BLOCKED               → HTTP 429  (raised by ThrottledError / DRF Throttled → exception_handler)
SESSION_REVOKED             → HTTP ???  (defined in enum; NOT raised in any view read — UNKNOWN where raised)

# Workspace
WORKSPACE_NOT_ACTIVE        → HTTP ???  (defined; likely raised in TenantResolverMiddleware or lifecycle service — not in views read)
WORKSPACE_FROZEN            → HTTP ???  (defined; likely raised in lifecycle/middleware — not in views read)
WORKSPACE_DEACTIVATED       → HTTP ???  (defined; likely raised in lifecycle/middleware — not in views read)
GRACE_PERIOD_RESTRICTED     → HTTP ???  (defined; likely raised by GracePeriodGate — not confirmed)
SUBDOMAIN_TAKEN             → HTTP 409  (defined; likely raised in subdomain check service)
ILLEGAL_TRANSITION          → HTTP ???  (defined; likely raised in workspace lifecycle transitions)

# Enrollment
ALREADY_ENROLLED            → HTTP 409  (defined; likely raised in enrollment service)
NOT_ENROLLED                → HTTP ???  (defined)
ENROLLMENT_EXPIRED          → HTTP ???  (defined)
ACCESS_DENIED               → HTTP 403  (defined)
HAS_ACTIVE_PAID_ENROLLMENTS → HTTP ???  (defined)

# Groups
GROUP_FULL                  → HTTP ???  (defined)
ALREADY_IN_GROUP_FOR_SUBJECT→ HTTP ???  (defined)

# Billing
SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVE         → HTTP ???  (defined)
SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_FOUND      → HTTP ???  (defined)
PAYMENT_PENDING             → HTTP ???  (defined)
DUPLICATE_PAYMENT           → HTTP ???  (defined)
QUOTE_STALE                 → HTTP ???  (defined)
UPGRADE_WOULD_SHORTEN_PERIOD→ HTTP ???  (defined)
UPGRADE_MIN_CHARGE          → HTTP ???  (defined)
UPGRADE_MIN_REMAINING       → HTTP ???  (defined)
UPGRADE_NOT_ELIGIBLE        → HTTP ???  (defined)

# Payments
POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_PROOF    → HTTP ???  (defined)
REJECTION_REASON_REQUIRED   → HTTP ???  (defined)
OVER_REFUND                 → HTTP ???  (defined)

# Limits
LIMIT_EXCEEDED              → HTTP 409  (from LimitExceeded exception class; includes limit_key, limit, current, remedy)

# Exams
ATTEMPT_EXPIRED             → HTTP ???  (defined)
ALREADY_SUBMITTED           → HTTP ???  (defined)
STALE_VERSION               → HTTP ???  (defined)
ATTEMPT_LIMIT_REACHED       → HTTP ???  (defined)

# Files
FILE_QUARANTINED            → HTTP ???  (defined)
FILE_PENDING_SCAN           → HTTP ???  (defined)
FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED       → HTTP ???  (defined)
FILE_TOO_LARGE              → HTTP ???  (defined)
PATH_TRAVERSAL              → HTTP ???  (defined)

# Generic
NOT_FOUND                   → HTTP 404  (raised everywhere via NotFound domain exception; also via Http404)
PERMISSION_DENIED           → HTTP 403  (raised by DRF PermissionDenied and PermissionDeniedError)
VALIDATION_ERROR            → HTTP 422  (raised by ValidationFailed domain exception)
                                        (also used for DRF ValidationError → HTTP 400 actually, see below)
CONFLICT                    → HTTP 409  (raised by Conflict domain exception)
INTERNAL_ERROR              → HTTP 500  (fallback for unhandled exceptions)
EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR      → HTTP 503  (raised by ExternalServiceError)
EXPORT_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED → HTTP ???  (defined; UNKNOWN if raised anywhere — not seen in read files)

## HTTP STATUS MAPPING (from apps/core/errors.py exception_handler)

Domain exceptions use their class's http_status:
  ValidationFailed      → 422 (HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY)
  NotFound              → 404
  PermissionDeniedError → 403
  Conflict              → 409
  LimitExceeded         → 409
  ThrottledError        → 429
  ExternalServiceError  → 503
  DomainError (base)    → 500

DRF built-ins mapped:
  NotAuthenticated / AuthenticationFailed → 401 (code: "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED" — NOT in ErrorCode enum)
  PermissionDenied                        → 403 (code: PERMISSION_DENIED)
  DRFValidationError                      → 400 (code: VALIDATION_ERROR)
  Throttled                               → 429 (code: LOGIN_BLOCKED)
  Http404                                 → 404 (code: NOT_FOUND)

## ERROR ENVELOPE SHAPE (all errors)

{
  "error": {
    "code": "<ErrorCode value>",
    "detail": "<human-readable message>",
    // Additional fields when present:
    "fields": {...}           // DRF ValidationError only — field-level errors
    "retry_after": <int>      // ThrottledError / Throttled only — seconds
    "limit_key": "<key>",     // LimitExceeded only
    "limit": <number>,
    "current": <number>,
    "remedy": "<string>"
  },
  "request_id": "<uuid>"
}

## NOTE: "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED" is raised in exception_handler but is NOT in the ErrorCode enum.
## It is a bare string literal used for NotAuthenticated/AuthenticationFailed responses.

## CODES DEFINED IN ENUM BUT NOT SEEN RAISED IN ANY VIEW/SERVICE READ:
SESSION_REVOKED, WORKSPACE_NOT_ACTIVE, WORKSPACE_FROZEN, WORKSPACE_DEACTIVATED,
GRACE_PERIOD_RESTRICTED, ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, ALREADY_ENROLLED, NOT_ENROLLED,
ENROLLMENT_EXPIRED, ACCESS_DENIED, HAS_ACTIVE_PAID_ENROLLMENTS, GROUP_FULL,
ALREADY_IN_GROUP_FOR_SUBJECT, SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVE, SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_FOUND,
PAYMENT_PENDING, DUPLICATE_PAYMENT, QUOTE_STALE, UPGRADE_WOULD_SHORTEN_PERIOD,
UPGRADE_MIN_CHARGE, UPGRADE_MIN_REMAINING, UPGRADE_NOT_ELIGIBLE,
POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_PROOF, REJECTION_REASON_REQUIRED, OVER_REFUND,
ATTEMPT_EXPIRED, ALREADY_SUBMITTED, STALE_VERSION, ATTEMPT_LIMIT_REACHED,
FILE_QUARANTINED, FILE_PENDING_SCAN, FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED, FILE_TOO_LARGE,
PATH_TRAVERSAL, SUBDOMAIN_TAKEN, EXPORT_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED
(These are almost certainly raised in service-layer files not yet read.
 They exist and are reachable — just not verified from views directly.)

## ARABIC MESSAGE TEMPLATES
NOT IMPLEMENTED — the codebase uses English detail strings throughout.
LANGUAGE_CODE="ar" is set but no Arabic error message templates were found
in the files read. All error detail strings in exceptions and error_handler are English.
